title: Detailed balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='balloonGrad' cx='38%' cy='32%' r='65%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b8a'/>
      <stop offset='45%' stop-color='#e8304a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#9e0f2e'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='shineGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd0d8' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffd0d8' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- balloon body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='28' ry='33' fill='url(#balloonGrad)'/>

  <!-- lighter edge shade for definition -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='28' ry='33' fill='none' stroke='#c43050' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- highlight shine -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='26' rx='11' ry='14' fill='url(#shineGrad)' transform='rotate(-18 40 26)'/>

  <!-- small secondary highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='21' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#ffe0e6' opacity='0.7' transform='rotate(-20 35 21)'/>

  <!-- balloon knot / tie -->
  <polygon points='47,70 53,70 50,75' fill='#b01a38'/>
  <rect x='47.5' y='72' width='5' height='3' rx='1' fill='#9e0f2e'/>

  <!-- string -->
  <path d='M50,75 C48,80 52,84 49,89 C47,92 51,95 50,98' stroke='#ffb3c1' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- tiny ribbon curls on string -->
  <path d='M49,83 C45,82 44,85 47,86' stroke='#ffb3c1' stroke-width='1.3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M51,92 C55,91 56,94 53,95' stroke='#ffb3c1' stroke-width='1.3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
